text: I understand your frustration and that you want this resolved now. Since you're asking to speak with someone who can actually fix this situation and the available tools don't allow me to process returns on pending orders, I'll transfer you to a human agent who may have additional options available.
zh: 我理解您的沮丧，并且您希望现在解决这个问题。由于您要求与一位能实际解决此情况的人交谈，而可用的工具不允许我在待处理订单上处理退货，我将转接一位人类客服，他们可能有额外的选项。
